hub.title: Steel Goods Receipt Process Center
hub.description: Trace every plate by DCode from gate check-in and quality decision through goods receipt and final putaway.

gate.title: Gate and Expectation
gate.description: Validate vehicle, driver, supplier and expected plate data before processing.

quality.title: Inspection and Decision
quality.description: Record physical arrival, quantity and quality decision for each plate with evidence.

putaway.title: Receipt and Putaway
putaway.description: Convert approved plates to tasks and post final inventory movements after physical receipt.

report.title: Monitoring and Reporting
report.description: Monitor plate traceability, pending work and operational exceptions from one center.

vehicles.title: Vehicle Check-In Records
vehicles.description: Review gate records and start a new vehicle and steel acceptance from the list action.

import.title: Expectation Import
import.description: Preview, validate and save Excel data idempotently by DCode.

plans.title: Steel Plans
plans.description: Track imported batches and their process statuses.

inspection.title: Arrival and Quality Inspection
inspection.description: Manage arrived, missing, accepted, partially accepted and rejected decisions.

receipt.title: Goods Receipt Task
receipt.description: Convert approved plates to a shared task and assign warehouse operators.

placement.title: Yard / Location Putaway
placement.description: Save the final location and stack order using current location occupancy.

reports.title: Steel Operation Reports
reports.description: Search DCode, supplier serial, quality, receipt and putaway statuses.
